missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Отсутствие' is in the nominative as the subject of 'удивило'. 'Его' marks whose absence it is, and 'всех' is the accusative object. A clean cause-and-effect model.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Отсутствие' is the accusative direct object of 'заметил'. As a neuter noun the accusative matches the nominative. 'Сразу' adds immediacy. A natural observation.
Strategic focus: Genitive modifier. 'Отсутствия' is in the genitive, modifying 'причина' to mean the cause of the absence. 'Неизвестна' is the short-form predicate. A formal explanatory pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative with 'к'. 'Отсутствию' is in the dative after 'к', the form required by 'привыкнуть к'. 'Его' marks whose absence. A useful pattern for adjustment.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with 'недоволен'. 'Отсутствием' is in the instrumental, the case governed by 'недоволен'. 'Его' marks whose absence it is. A common complaint pattern.

Strategic focus: Accusative in a set phrase. 'Отсутствие' is in the accusative within the fixed phrase 'в отсутствие', meaning in the absence of. 'Начальника' is a genitive modifier. A useful formal expression.
Strategic focus: Prepositional with 'при'. 'Отсутствии' is in the prepositional after 'при', meaning in the case of absence. 'Воды' is a genitive modifier. A useful conditional construction.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Отсутствия' is the nominative plural subject of 'портят'. 'Долгие' agrees in the plural, and 'отношения' is the accusative plural object. A reflective sentence.

Strategic focus: Genitive with 'из-за'. 'Отсутствия' is in the genitive after 'из-за', marking the cause. 'Денег' is a genitive modifier, and 'поездка отменилась' is the result. A common causal pattern.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Отсутствие' is the nominative subject of the equational sentence. 'Новостей' is a genitive modifier, and 'это хорошо' is the predicate. A familiar saying.
